problem.title: Convert Binary Number in a Linked List to Integer
problem.problemStatement: The nodes of a singly linked list contain only 0 or 1. The linked list represents a binary number, with the most significant bit at the head. Return the decimal value represented by the linked list.
problem.input: Integer n Linked list containing only 0 and 1
problem.output: A single integer representing the decimal value.
